_comment: CCV-L23's declared table (DA rev 131 form; DA 130, OI-184's lag-1 option) for ooe_redir.sv's PWV form: each slot's redirect warp and epoch, written in its resolution's cycle and read by the send when the slot has waited (its checkpoint, mask, target and stay held in ooe_rob_w's own register, OA-487).

ew_cq04h.why: ooe_redir's waiting redirects' warps (S words, one a slot): a resolution writes its slot's word from ooe_decrx's cq03h warp; the send, at its own stage, reads a word through pw_cq03h only when that slot waited, an arriving slot's being the ports'. Neither a loop's back edge nor a later copy on the reader's pipeline. To be signed by OA in OI's landing row.

ee_cq04h.why: As ew_cq04h, for each waiting redirect's epoch (ooe_decrx's ep1_cq03h).
